title: Touch of Red (664)
problem: Each hit adds 25% × (hits − 1) of the base damage to the attack's bonus pool. The pool is only cleared before the first hit, so hit k gets k times that bonus. The community numbers are exact. The text implies the same bonus on every hit.
notes: Community claim: First hit gets +25% per extra attack, each later hit adds the same again (320 base, +2 attacks: 480 / 640 / 800). Evidence: bc_CreatureAttack L1253 @0x1406d7c00: (hits − 1) × 0.25, pool += @0x1406d801b; pool cleared only at L10 / L88. Fix sketch: H: clear the pool at the start of each hit. This changes every multi-hit "more damage" term, so it is a balance decision. Triage 2026-10-26: merged into SU-0038.
reason: duplicate of SU-0038 (multi-hit bonus pile-up), which is now fixed (normalized, user ruling 2026-10-26); Touch of Red's own term is SU-0176.
